>Bad wording on my part.

>Do corruption counter get removed from a minion when the controller of
>the corruption counters is ousted.

That was the question I thought you asked, actually.

I don't think counters have any "controller" - they're just on cards.
They burn when the card burns (or when some effect says to burn them).

Now Corruption counters have some idea of who played them (so that
you can tell "your" counters from other players'), so there may be
some hint of control there, but it isn't important, since only the
/cards/ you control are burned when you're ousted, according to
[1.3]. So the question of control isn't really important at this
point.



I am curious about this "loyalty of corruption counters".
In a given Scenario where Methuselah A is playing a Followers of
Set deck with corruption cards is preying on Methuselah B, who is
Playing a Superior Auspex Eagle sight deck. Methuselah B is preying
on Methuselah C who is playin a Followers of Set Deck with Venenation.
Methuselah A has placed 2 corruption counters on Zoe who is controlled
by Methuselah B.

During Methuselah C's turn Zoe blocks an action by Methuselah C'
Aisha by using an Eagle Sight. Aisha then plays venenation. Zoe now
has 3 corruption counters on her.

Are you saying that That methuselah C cannot burn the three corruption
counters to take control of Zoe even though that is what the card text
states?

No. I'm saying that Methuselah C cannot burn the three corruption
counters to take control of Zoe /because/ that is what the card text
states.

Card text indicates that the counters to be counter are the counters
that are "yours", and therefore the counters must have some sort of
idea as to whose counters they are.
